about: Where each model's nose art is painted (Tools/pack_nose_art.py): in the model file's own frame (metres, x forward, y right, z up), port and starboard. cover: the part of the picture (u0, v0, u1, v1) the panel is laid over, all of every painting's paint. points: the panel's grid, rows from the painting's top, each [x, y, z, nx, ny, nz, u, v], laid on her near shape and lifted lift_m off it along her skin's facing; u along the painting from its left edge, v down it from its top, so it reads from left to right seen from outside either side. middle, normal, up and right: at its middle point (right the way u grows). skin: the paint it lies on. off_mm: how far its triangles are off her skin, least and most.
